content: TASK requests a structurally distinct proof and verbatim PROBLEM.md statement on submission. gm_search found no master_guidance, findings, dead ends, or verification traces; fact_search found no facts. Matlas returned no relevant theorem. Official solutions found by web use Taylor/coefficient expansion, so pursue a distinct complex-root multiplicity proof. Text-only mathematics.

Set F=p-x. For a complex root alpha of multiplicity m, write F(alpha+t)=t^m u(t), u(0) nonzero. Since p(alpha+t)-alpha=t+t^m u(t), one has F(p(alpha+t))=t^m(1+t^{m-1}u(t))^m u(t+t^m u(t)). The identity is F(p(x))+F(x)=F(x)^2q(x). If m>=2 the bracket after factoring t^m has value 2u(0), contradicting divisibility by t^{2m}. Hence m=1. Then that bracket at zero is u(0)(2+u(0)), so u(0)=-2. Thus all roots of nonconstant F are simple and zeros of F'+2. If deg F=n, there are n distinct complex roots, forcing F'+2=0 because its degree is at most n-1. Therefore F=-2x+c. Constant F yields translations. Verify both families directly.

The complete target theorem, with the verbatim PROBLEM.md statement and the root-multiplicity proof, was accepted as fact da4178fd60b46ed0. The verifier reported alpha as an undefined-symbol warning even though alpha was explicitly introduced in the proof and supplied in the glossary under its LaTeX spelling; acceptance and fact write both succeeded.
